titles: 15 Things Every Family Did on 1960s Road Trips — Unthinkable Today
15 Road Trip Habits From the 1960s Only People Over 60 Remember
15 Things We Did on Every 1960s Road Trip You'd Never Do Today
description_intro:
Pack the cooler and climb into the way-back. These 1960s road trip memories take you back to the days of no seat belts, free paper maps, hot vinyl seats and a dad who simply would not stop until the gas gauge said so.

From the license plate game and rhyming roadside signs to the full-service attendant, the neon motel with a pool and the best seat in the whole station wagon, this is a road trip just like the ones you took.

Which of these did your family do? Tell us where you grew up and where you were headed, and share your favorite road trip memory in the comments.
